description: Tests for IsolationForest behavior on very small datasets. Robustness category O.

fixtures.input_condition: Dataset with only 2 records total (minimum possible non-trivial dataset)

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Ravi Malhotra observed at Andheri Warehouse.
TEST FIXTURE: Suresh Nair observed at Andheri Warehouse.

fixtures.expected_behavior: IsolationForest may raise ValueError or produce degenerate results on 2-record datasets. The pipeline should handle this gracefully with a try/except or min-size check.
fixtures.rationale: IsolationForest requires sufficient data diversity to establish a meaningful anomaly boundary. sklearn's IsolationForest may raise an error or mark all points as anomalies on datasets with 2 records.
fixtures.weakness_description: IsolationForest may crash or produce degenerate results on datasets with fewer than ~10 records. The anomaly detection module should enforce a minimum dataset size and return a warning rather than crashing. The production threshold should be documented and enforced with a graceful fallback.

fixtures.input_condition: All records on the same date — no variance in daily counts

fixtures.expected_behavior: All records on same date. Daily count vector has only one unique value. IsolationForest has zero variance to work with. May return all anomalous, none anomalous, or crash.
fixtures.rationale: Zero variance in the feature vector causes IsolationForest to behave unpredictably. The expected behavior is non-deterministic without specific sklearn version constraints.
fixtures.weakness_description: IsolationForest on a zero-variance feature vector (all records on same date) produces undefined behavior. The anomaly detection module must handle this case explicitly and return a documented warning.
